package org.apache.tika.digest;

/**
 * Encodes byte array from a MessageDigest to String.
 * Common implementations encode to hex or base32 format.
 */
public interface Encoder {

    /**
     * Encode a byte array to a string representation.
     *
     * @param bytes the bytes to encode (typically from MessageDigest.digest())
     * @return the encoded string representation
     */
    String encode(byte[] bytes);
}
